_about: Where the Transhuman Radar gets its headlines. Every morning tools/build.mjs --refresh reads these feeds, keeps the last `max_age_days` of items, sorts each into a pillar and writes data/radar.json. mode 'fixed' puts every item in `pillar`; 'classify' sorts by the keywords below and falls back to `pillar` (or drops the item when `pillar` is null); "match": "title" makes a broad source count title keywords only. Weight lifts a source's items (1 = normal). Headlines link to the publisher; nothing else is copied.
